summary: Assist Custer County SAR with two Tier III hoist techs for rescue of 2 climbers on Crestone Needle (2020-108)
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team; Custer County SAR
notes: ART mission 2020-108. Subject outcomes not stated. | Run-131 merge: SnowBrains video account (opened) confirms the two climbers spent the night at 13,850 ft on Crestone Needle; one slipped from an icy crack and fell ~30 ft with minor leg injuries; Colorado National Guard helicopter airlift (Alpine assist); incident in September 2020 consistent with ART mission 2020-108 (2020-09-19). | Merged at run 228 (2026-09-12): mtntownmagazine.com SAR feature recounts the same rescue — climber fell ~30 ft onto a snow-covered ledge on Crestone Needle, badly injured ankle; overnight 911 call, Alpine Rescue + Army Guard helicopter response, Guard hoist by Dale Atkins, both climbers flown out by lunchtime (full recovery for the injured climber per the feature). Run-647 merge: COARNG Aug-27-2021 DUSTOFF Rescue-of-the-Year award article (parent-opened) — CHRT aircrew + Alpine Rescue Team hoist rescue of injured hiker from Crestone Needle, Sept. 19, 2020. Meridian Winter 2021 "Team Honored for Hoist Rescue": 30-ft fall on near-vertical technical face (broken-ankle report downgraded to sprain in flight); Buckley-origin Blackhawk, first hoist attempt aborted for warm-air performance, ~400 lb lightened, successful dynamic hoist with Alpine member Dale Atkins lowered to ledge; subjects flown to Alamosa; team received Dustoff Assoc 2020 Rescue of the Year (presented Aug 2021, Columbus GA); injured climber returned the following July to finish the route. 2026-09-18: merged MRA retrospective video of the 2020 Crestone Needle hoist rescue.
